name: champagne-gold-sequin-dress-wide-angle-selfie
image_purpose: Party outfit post and social-media fit check

prompt.project_info: Create a raw high-contrast wide-angle smartphone fit-check selfie on a domestic sofa.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman matching the required face reference, wearing a champagne-gold glittery strapless mini dress with realistic sequin sparkle and a delicate gold chain necklace with a small blue-and-white evil-eye pendant. She reclines comfortably on a sofa and holds the phone high for the selfie.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 0.5x wide-angle selfie, sharp from glossy lips and dress texture to the gray sofa cushion and beige leather-grain sofa back. Keep the right arm and phone visible, with a slight natural twist rather than an exaggerated pose.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct smartphone-style indoor flash creating controlled starburst reflections on sequins, balanced by realistic room ambient light and visible digital grain in shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: iPhone 17 Pro simulation, 0.5x wide-angle, 9:16, no artificial bokeh, everything in believable focus, raw unedited social-media dump aesthetic, realistic skin and sequin texture, high dynamic range without plastic smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A raw high-contrast vertical 9:16 0.5x wide-angle smartphone selfie of one approved adult woman matching the required face reference, reclining comfortably on a sofa and holding the phone high with her right arm. She wears a champagne-gold glittery strapless mini dress with realistic sequin sparkle and a delicate gold chain necklace with a small blue-and-white evil-eye pendant. Keep the gray textured cushion and beige leather-grain sofa back sharp and believable, with direct smartphone-style flash producing controlled starburst reflections on the dress, realistic skin texture, digital grain in the shadows, and an unedited social-media fit-check atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, explicit body-part emphasis, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, artificial bokeh, harsh blown highlights, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur

Sofa texture and minor background details may be replaced; do not invent logos or typography. Any replacement person must be an approved adult.

changes: Clarified the subject as an approved adult and replaced exaggerated body-emphasis and seductive-pose wording with a comfortable natural pose while preserving the sequin fit-check concept.
